key_highlights: David Jones collapses into voluntary administration after failed landlord talks, posing severe headwinds for retail REITs and unpaid suppliers.
ASX 200 (^AXJO) finishes week higher following an $80b US midterms relief rally, though NAB slumps sharply.
NextDC (NXT.AX) surges amid ongoing institutional demand for AI-driven data centre infrastructure.
Qantas (QAN.AX) cuts flight capacity and hikes airfares in response to a $1 billion fuel cost surge.
RBA maintains hawkish bias citing excess demand and persistent inflation, elevating risks for the domestic housing market.

sectors.trend: Severe distress in department stores with David Jones entering administration and shutting multiple locations.
sectors.implications: Elevated vacancy risks and renegotiation pressure for major retail landlords (SCG.AX, VCX.AX), alongside liquidity crunches for exposed suppliers.

sectors.trend: Banking sector divergence marked by a sharp drop in NAB despite broad market gains.
sectors.implications: Sticky inflation, RBA tightening pressure, and property downturn warnings heighten asset quality and margin concerns for major banks (NAB.AX, CBA.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX).

sectors.trend: Structural outperformance in digital and cloud infrastructure post-US midterms.
sectors.implications: NXT.AX benefits from secular AI expansion and data storage demand, decoupling from broader macroeconomic sluggishness.

sectors.trend: Robust junior exploration funding with active gold equity raisings and critical mineral discoveries.
sectors.implications: Selective speculative momentum in gold and base/battery metals (CHN.AX, CRR.AX, BPM.AX, KNI.AX), while large-cap miners track global demand.

sectors.trend: Airlines grappling with lagged fuel cost inflation despite broader crude oil weakness.
sectors.implications: Qantas (QAN.AX) faces operational margin defense challenges via fare increases, testing discretionary travel demand resilience.

key_themes: Discretionary consumer capitulation highlighted by marquee retail insolvencies
Macroeconomic divergence between buoyant global tech sentiment and domestic monetary tightening
Mounting household debt and housing market correction pressures amid RBA excess demand warnings

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Commercial Property & Retail Supply Chain Contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight discretionary retail REITs; focus on non-discretionary grocery-anchored assets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Prolonged RBA Restrictive Policy & Housing Downturn
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to rate-sensitive lenders; increase defensive cash and floating-rate yields.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Aviation & Industrial Cost Inflation Pass-Through Friction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Target companies with high pricing power and low fuel/transport sensitivity.

opportunities.rationale: Strong structural AI tailwinds and post-election market clarity support robust earnings growth.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Allocation to Gold Explorers and Producers
opportunities.rationale: High deal flow and new mineral discoveries provide hedging value against inflation and geopolitical risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Exposure to Major Banking Majors
defensive_moves.rationale: Underperformance in NAB and mounting credit headwinds warrant cautious stance on bank multiples.
David Jones collapse risks tenancy voids, leasing write-downs, and lower retail foot traffic.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) to experience consolidation around current levels as post-US midterm euphoria balances against domestic consumer and banking headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Persistent inflation and housing market adjustments will restrict cyclical domestic growth, favouring secular technology and quality resource exporters.
